name: Tectona Ltd
summary: Tectona Ltd. engages in blockchain activity and digital assets. Its business operations include: Tectona Financial Services, Tectona Proprietary Trading, Tectona Labs, and Tectona Ventues. Tectona Financial Services develops a suite of technical and blockchain related financial instruments. Tectona Proprietary Trading focuses on advanced trading products, which leverage algorithmic strategies and high-frequency trading in the sectors of cryptocurrency and Decentralized Finance (DeFi). Tectona Labs includes digital offerings in the non-fungible token (NFT) space. Tectona Ventures partners with and invests in founders and technologies in DeFi, Web3, NFTs, and Play-to-Earn verticals. The company was founded on July 19, 1981 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
